title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Post one positive upward correction against the original shared snapshot line. This increases the compute receivable by the supplied amount and records an equal untaxed net component. The returned event identifier confirms success.

## Invocation

debit_compute_snapshot_133263fe is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for snapshot debit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for snapshot debit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the approved incorrect snapshot arithmetic review for the original charge, copied from its successful review receipt or find_compute_events; use the identical review reference supplied in related_event_id.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — The original snapshot invoice reference for snapshot debit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — The export, allocation or approved review reference for snapshot debit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter amount

`amount`: Fixed-format class — The amount in units of USD, representation USD to two decimals; supplied already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded snapshot debit by its new business event reference and confirms its posted registration and the business effect described above.
